The '''First Knowledge quarter''' of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] is the working title of the northwestern side of the ancient edifice. Crowned by the [[Tower of First Knowledge/Legends|Tower of First Knowledge]] this section of the Temple was infused with rooms dedicated to study and research, along with facilities for the [[Jedi training/Legends|tutelage]] of the [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|future]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knights]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] combat.

==History==
When the Jedi Temple was first established circa [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]] by the group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] collectively known as the [[Four Masters/Legends|Four Masters]], the Jedi initially built small meditation facilities to service the diplomats that resided on Coruscant. However, following the [[Battle of Ossus (Great Sith War)|Devastation of]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] and the [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|Great Jedi Library]] located there, the Order relocated its [[Jedi academy|academy]] to the Temple and began to expand. As the Ziggurat took shape and the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] towers soared over the [[Temple district/Legends|Temple Precinct]], the First Knowledge quarter became recognizable.<ref name="SWCL" />

While the Temple would stand proud for several centuries, it was largely destroyed during the [[Sacking of Coruscant]] when the resurgent [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] attacked the capitol.<ref name="Deceived" /> The [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] would later fund the reconstruction of the Temple and the northeastern wing was rebuilt with the [[Tower of First Knowledge/Legends|Tower of First Knowledge]] being completed in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]. The Temple would stand as a beacon of hope in the galaxy for the next millennia, offering comfort to the misbegotten and oppressed.<ref name="SWCL" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], at the height of the three year long [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Temple was placed under martial law by the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the Republic who secretly was in fact the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]. Sidious sent the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] against the Temple under the pretense of a "Jedi Rebellion". The [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] executed an operation known as [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Knightfall]] during which they slaughtered all of the Jedi present at the Temple under the leadership of [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. Within the First Knowledge quarter, the troopers slaughtered all of the younglings present here, including the infants within the nurseries.<ref name="ROTS" /> Darth Vader confront Knight [[Serra Keto]] within one of the [[Jedi Temple communication center/Legends|communication centers]] near the First Knowledge Tower and would proceed to kill her in one of the training halls at the base of spire.<ref name="EPIIIVG">[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' video game]]</ref> After completing his work at the top of the Ziggurat the Sith descended to the [[Room of a Thousand Fountains/Legends|Room of a Thousand Fountains]] and killed Keto's Master, [[Cin Drallig/Legends|Cin Drallig]], and the younglings he protected there.<ref name="ROTSN">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref>

Following the abandonment of the Temple, the quarter was sparsely populated aside from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] agents rummaging through the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]]. In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]] slaughtered all of the [[Shadow stormtrooper/Legends|Shadow Troopers]] guarding the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|main entrance]] to the First Knowledge Tower, along with several [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] stationed in the Archives.<ref name="TFU">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>

==Layout==
[[File:JediClassroom.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A classroom in this section of the Temple.]]

The First Knowledge quarter was made up of several levels of chambers and rooms that were used for the education of Jedi and the research needed to unearth new knowledge. Many of the goings-on in this quarter were overseen by the [[Council of First Knowledge/Legends|Council of First Knowledge]] who met in the Tower that crowned this section of the Temple Ziggurat.<ref name="SWCL" />

On the first level of the quarter stood the seven story [[Room of a Thousand Fountains/Legends|Room of a Thousand Fountains]], a giant green house which evoked a meditative atmosphere used by all Jedi who resided at the Temple. The next level up was home to the [[Jedi Temple detention center|detention center]] in which those Jedi students who misbehaved and captured [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and their monstrosities were kept. The next level was occupied by the Offices of the [[Jedi Service Corps/Legends|Jedi Service Corps]]; including the [[Agricultural Corps Research Laboratories]], [[Halls of Healing]], and the offices of the [[Exploration Corps/Legends|Exploration Corps]]. As the area reached the peak of the Ziggurat, the classrooms used in the instruction of [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] were seen more frequently, as well as training chambers and verandas.The epicenter of this section were the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] and [[Jedi Archives|library]], which housed the near-infinite banks of knowledge from over a thousand generations of history. Incorporated into this area was the [[Analysis Rooms/Legends|Analysis wing]], a series of stations used in the analysis of artifacts from across the galaxy<ref name="SWCL" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:FKQ.jpg|thumb|250px|The possible non-canon duel between Vader and Drallig in the First Knowledge quarter.]]

In [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (video game)|''Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith'' game]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] confronts [[Serra Keto]] and [[Cin Drallig/Legends|Cin Drallig]] near the base of the [[Tower of First Knowledge/Legends|Tower of First Knowledge]]. While this is the [[canon]] site of Keto's death, Cin Drallig is shown to die in the [[Room of a Thousand Fountains/Legends|Room of a Thousand Fountains]] in the [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Revenge of the Sith'' novel]]. It perhaps can be reconciled by stating that Drallig first dueled Vader here, and later fled to the Fountain Room.
